Name: Moonlight Lamp
Author: ahomiepassingby
Description:
This is all from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11696]Moon lamp furniture[/url]. But I don't want my vanilla lamp to be replaced, and since it's the moon, I wonder why it's not on the wall instead of the floor.

[color=#AED6CF][b][size=4]Then, I made this. ✨
[/size][/b][/color]
My mod is only the CP version and includes both lamps and sconces (meaning you can choose to place it on the floor or the wall). 

You only have 2 ways to buy these: through random sale at Robin's shop, and the Furniture Catalogue.

To be installed, just download this and extract into the Mods folder.

[i][b][size=4]Hope you enjoy it![/size][/b][/i]
